quests.title: Step over one blocked cell
quests.ask: Write `go_around()`: facing a blocked cell in the bottom lane, climb up, pass it, and come back down just beyond it, facing right (east) again.
quests.nudge: Trace it with your finger. Where must the robot stand, and which way must it face, when it's done?

quests.title: A block right away
quests.ask: The very first cell ahead is blocked, and so is a cell in the top lane. Get past and walk to the bottom lane's far end, facing right (east).
quests.nudge: At every step the robot has two choices. Which one does it need here?

quests.title: A block near the end
quests.ask: The blocked cell is just before the end; the top lane has a block too. Finish on the bottom lane's far end, facing right (east), without bumping the wall.
quests.nudge: A detour carries the robot across more than one column. Does your walk still stop at the end?
